title: feat(spec): AuthSessionApi.getSession declares the result fields its readers read (session.id, token, impersonatedBy, user.email, authGate)
body:
Fixes #24196

Clause-②: yes

## What

`AuthSessionApi.getSession` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.ts`) says its result declares exactly the fields its in-process readers read, but it only declared `user.id`, `session.userId` and `session.activeOrganizationId`. This PR declares the other fields the card's readers read. Each one is optional, carries a TSDoc naming its reader, and is typed the way that reader takes it:

| Declared | Type | Reader |
|---|---|---|
| `user.email` | `string` | `resolveAuthzContext` session arm (`@objectstack/core`) → `ctx.email` |
| `user.authGate` | `unknown` | `normalizeAuthGate` from the session arm. It validates the value against the closed posture vocabulary, so the contract declares it unvalidated, which is how that reader takes it |
| `session.id` | `string` | session arm, dropped-claim log line (the row id, never the token) |
| `session.token` | `string` | session arm → `ctx.accessToken` |
| `session.impersonatedBy` | `string` or `null` | print door `impersonatorOf` (`@objectstack/service-print`). The stored column `sys_session.impersonated_by` is a nullable lookup, and better-auth's admin plugin types it `string` or `undefined` |

The two readers now read through the declared type. Both changes are type-only:

- **`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`**: the session arm's `sessionData` is annotated with the type `AuthSessionApi.getSession` declares it answers (`SessionRead`, derived locally with `Awaited`/`ReturnType`, so no new export). Before, it was the `any` that `getSession`'s input type returns. ⛔ `ResolveAuthzInput.getSession`'s own type is **left at `any`**. Tightening it would narrow a published input of `@objectstack/core`, which is a `(narrowing)` arm and breaking, and this card is a widening. That option goes back to the seat as an open question.
- **`packages/services/service-print/src/print-routes.ts`**: `impersonatorOf` takes the declared `SessionRead` instead of `unknown`. That drops the `as { session?: { impersonatedBy?: unknown } }` cast. The same branches run on the same values: the optional chain replaces cast-then-chain, and the `typeof by === 'string'` narrowing stays.

`packages/types/src/in-process-session-read.contract.test.ts` (H4) pins the declaration's INPUT key for key (`DeclaredInput`), never the result. It needed no change and passes unchanged.

## Verification

All of this ran at `7a60e0e5bb`. The later merge of `origin/main` (`b7f29ddfe2`) brought only cli / metadata-protocol / rest / runtime / platform-objects files, none of which this diff touches.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` → exit 0. `check:generated` → exit 0, "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". No artifact changed: the result type is inline in an existing export.
- Typecheck, downstream of `@objectstack/spec`, after building each package's closure: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/service-print` → exit 0. Then the four packages that implement or read `AuthSessionApi`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (its `AuthManager.getApi()` answers better-auth's own API, which still fits the widened result), `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/service-datasource`, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` → exit 0. plugin-auth's examples leg resolves plugin-auth's own `dist`, so it was re-run after building it.
- Tests: `@objectstack/core` 109 files / 2617 tests passed. `@objectstack/service-print` 8 / 109 passed. `@objectstack/types` 27 / 759 passed.
- Reverse verification, committed first, mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored and checked as `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - core `session?.token` → `session?.tokenRenamed`: `tsc` exit 2, `TS2339: Property 'tokenRenamed' does not exist on type '{ userId?…; id?…; token?…; impersonatedBy?… }'`.
  - print `session?.impersonatedBy;` → `session?.impersonatorId;`: `tsc` exit 2, TS2339 on the same declared type.
  - A first print attempt used a replacement that contained its own anchor. The tool refused it (anchor 1 → 1) and restored the file. That attempt measured nothing, and the second leg above is the reading.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` (84 families, change set derived against merge base `8259ea03e`): 83 exit 0. The one exception is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's `dist`, and this box built only the closures above. It is NOT MEASURED locally and is CI's reading. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 on a shallow clone. After `git fetch --unshallow` it exits 0 (48 cases). `--ran` reconciliation: 84 derived, 83 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (derived from the recorded exit 3).

## Acceptance notes

The other `getSession` callers were **read, not edited** (the hold-off). Their reads of the result still go through `any` or a cast. Read on this branch:

- `plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`: `:2839` and `:3229` call `(authApi as any).getSession(…)`. `:3229` also casts the result to `{ user?: { id?: unknown } }`. `:2776` and `:2911` are typed by better-auth's `Auth['api']`, not `AuthSessionApi`. All four hand the session to `judgePlatformAdmin` / `isPlatformAdminUser`, which take `unknown` and cast. They read `user.isPlatformAdmin`, `user.role`, `user.email`, `user.id` and `user.authGate`.
- `rest/src/rest-server.ts:3416`: `gatedSession: any` → `normalizeAuthGate(gatedSession?.user)`. The closure at `:3202` goes to `resolveAuthzContext`.
- `runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts:214`: `const session: any` → `evaluateAuthGate`. `runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:1556` (`let session: any` → `evaluateAuthGate`) and `:1678` (implicitly `any`; reads `user.id`, `session.userId`, `session.activeOrganizationId`). `runtime/src/security/resolve-session-principal.ts:57`: `api: any`; its callers read `user.id` / `session.userId`.
- `cloud-connection-plugin.ts:317` (`any` → `evaluateAuthGate`, then `resolveAuthzContext`). `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:3352` reads `session.activeOrganizationId` **or a top-level `activeOrganizationId`**. `service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts:1176` reads the same top-level fallback.
- `plugin-webhooks/src/webhook-outbox-plugin.ts:627` and `service-storage` `:953` / `:1279`: `any`, then `evaluateAuthGate` and `user.id` / `session.activeOrganizationId`.
- `normalizeAuthGate` / `evaluateAuthGate` (`packages/core/src/security/auth-gate.ts`) keep their `any` parameter. They also validate non-session input (`{ authGate: raw }` from `resolveUserAuthGates`, and deliberately malformed test fixtures). Typing them is a separate change, not this card's.

The fields only those callers read (`user.role`, `user.isPlatformAdmin`, the top-level `activeOrganizationId`) are **not** declared here. The card scopes the declaration to its named readers, and each of those callers would have to drop its cast for the declaration to have a reader.
